display.name: Agent Services
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['service_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE match(metric_name, '^(?:demo_tool_calls_total|demo_chatbot_requests_total|gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count)$')
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

display.name: Tool calls
display.description: Rate of Astronomy Shop tool calls made by the agent service (direct calls) and the mcp service (proxied calls). Source: demo.tool.calls.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('sum(rate(demo_tool_calls_total{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Distinct tools invoked
display.description: Number of distinct Astronomy Shop tools invoked by the agent/mcp services in the selected time range.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('count(count by (gen_ai_tool_name) (demo_tool_calls_total{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Tool call rate by tool
display.description: Rate of demo.tool.calls broken down by tool name (gen_ai.tool.name), summed across the agent and mcp services.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (rate(demo_tool_calls_total{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

display.name: Token usage rate (input vs output)
display.description: Rate of input/output tokens consumed, from the langchain instrumentation's gen_ai.client.token.usage histogram (auto-emitted once a MeterProvider is configured; not a demo-defined metric).

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

display.name: LLM call duration (p95)
display.description: p95 LLM call duration by response model, from the langchain instrumentation's gen_ai.client.operation.duration histogram.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service_name
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_response_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_service_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time
